  Readable gloss: "A feminine noun denoting a young girl or damsel, particularly of marriageable age. The term captures the poignancy of youth—whether in tragedy (Dinah, the enslaved children of Joel) or hope (Zechariah's peaceful future). Unlike נַעֲרָה which can imply servitude, יַלְדָּה emphasizes youth and potential."
